//: claurdvoyant <-> Codex lifecycle hooks. Place at ~/.codex/hooks.json. Codex implements a Claude-Code-compatible hooks system: each event (SessionStart, Stop, ...) maps to an array of { hooks: [ { type: 'command', command: '<shell>' } ] }. The hook command receives a JSON payload on stdin whose fields include cwd, session_id, hook_event_name (Stop also adds last_assistant_message, turn_id). Confirmed against codex-rs/core/tests/suite/hooks.rs and codex-rs/hooks/schema/generated/{session-start,stop}.command.input.schema.json. Replace /path/to/... with your built binaries.

hooks.command: CWD="$(jq -r '.cwd // empty')"; /path/to/cv ls --cwd "${CWD:-$PWD}" --limit 8; /path/to/cv board read fleet --limit 5
hooks.statusMessage: claurdvoyant: surfacing prior sessions + fleet board

hooks.command: CWD="$(jq -r '.cwd // empty')"; /path/to/cvd sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; /path/to/cv board post fleet "codex finished in ${CWD:-$PWD}" --from codex --kind status >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
hooks.statusMessage: claurdvoyant: archiving + posting to fleet board
